text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Thursday, February 22, 2018 Posted by admin on February 22nd, 2018 
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include JPMorgan (JPM). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows. 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open UP +35 points. 
Wednesday the Dow was down -166.97 (-0.67%) at 24,797.78. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +0.32%. 
There were 4 Dow stocks up Wednesday. 
The Dow stock winners Wednesday were led by United Technologies (UTX) +2.21% and McDonald’s (MCD) +0.94%. 
The Dow stock losers Wednesday were led by Wal-Mart (WMT) -2.75% and Verizon (VZ) -1.96%. 
Unemployment insurance weekly claims for the week ending February 17, seasonally adjusted initial claims was 222,000, a decrease of 7,000 from the previous week’s revised level. The previous week’s level was revised down by 1,000 from 230,000 to 229,000. The 4-week moving average was 226,000, a decrease of 2,250 from the previous week’s revised average. The previous week’s average was revised down by 250 from 228,500 to 228,250. 
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly lower. 
The national average price of gasoline is down one-tenth of a cent at $2.525 per gallon.
